title: Superior Potion of Healing Recipe
summary: Documents the formula for a Potion of Superior Healing.

fields.Recipe: Combine Salts of Musk Creeper and any Suspension. The resulting potion restores 8d4 + 8 HP.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
